bundle.shortDescription: Local token usage analytics for Ollama and DeepSeek
bundle.longDescription: TokenFlow is a local-first desktop companion that proxies Ollama traffic to measure token usage and polls the DeepSeek balance API. All telemetry stays on your machine.
